![](images/generated/e0306293c8523150376ce5f1ba7d13d30c9aec6e639a14be18a353f91e0c1f54.png)

The graph above shows the speed of cars $A$ and $B$ as a function of the distance that they traveled during a brake test. At which distance, in meters, did both cars reach the same speed?
question.:question/worked-solution:
The cars have the same speed when the two graphs intersect.

![](images/generated/49548231819003776eb56f93c0251dc97f2fd956cc7c402fbd876feec1414342.png)

In this case, we have the point $(90,40)$. So, both cars have the same speed ($40\,\textrm{km/h}$) at a distance of $90$ meters.
